method: hardware_splicer.distributor_check on KiCad netlists exported from the benchmark and reference boards (root sheets), against LCSC product records fetched 2026-11-26.

summary.judged_by_hand: Every error was read against the schematic fields and the LCSC record. All 55 remaining errors are real: codes for another value or package (17 resistors on brer-rabbit/zoxnoxious marked 10k 0603 carry C17936, a 4.7k 1206 part; 8 100 nF capacitors on ebastler/zmk-designguide carry a 1 uF code; Samsung CL32 1210 capacitors on LibreSolar/bms-c1 1206 pads).
summary.false_positives_fixed_before_this_record: LCSC's SOT-23-6L and SC-70-6 names for SOT-23-6 and SOT-363 outlines (5 findings); a listing whose package field contradicts its own name (C552486) is now a note; spaced values such as '22 µF' (88 findings).
summary.code_not_found: 18 codes return no product at LCSC on the day: delisted or never valid; the boards cannot be ordered under them.
